# Engine 14 release notes, iteration 3: the window's second week

## Context

Iteration 2 (#21085, Resolves #21083) read the window at 2026-11-16T02:20Z and said: "What merged later joins in iteration 3." Since then 241 pull requests merged into `dev` (GitHub search `is:pr base:dev merged:>=2026-11-16T02:20:00Z`, 2026-11-20T13:51Z). The window since 13.4.0 now holds 412 merged pull requests and 405 closed issues (11 not planned), against 169 and 158 in the note.

Two Friday reads are due before this iteration: #21140's gate read (posted, [comment 7041152372](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21140#issuecomment-7041152372): it does not pass) and #20874's generated-app check (Clio runs it, Vega reads it).

## The Problem

`.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v14.0.0.md` on `dev` (`5cb81df00a`) states facts the window has overtaken:

- The board is "due on `dev` by Thursday"; #20875 closed on 2026-11-17 (#21206), with its themes (#21344), card editor (#21224), the Workstation's board pane (#21223) and a guide by an outside contributor (#21234).
- The packages chapter counts 18 closed leaves and two open row-geometry leaves; all 21 subs of #20667 are closed (#21243, #21251).
- *Upgrading from 13.4.0* misses three changes a 13.4 workspace meets: the theme sources became plain CSS (#21217, #21225), the engine's file server replaced `webpack serve` (#21215, #21295; deposit [6984039691](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21032#issuecomment-6984039691)), and the package ships without the engine's spec files (#21313, #21314; deposit [6989540586](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21032#issuecomment-6989540586)).
- Arcs the note does not name at all, among them a web desktop family in `src/desktop` (#21199, #21200, #21201, #21202), the examples' groups overview and Start here (#21130, #21325, #21518), and CSS anchor positioning for popovers (#21423).
- The community table counts 29 accounts at 2026-11-16T01:40Z.

## The Architectural Reality

- The note's structure (release-notes §5) stays; this leaf updates its facts and adds what the second week delivered.
- Scope comes from live GitHub search, grouped by title scope (release-notes §2). Every claim is checked against its pull request's diff or its issue (§4).
- `Generate.spec.mjs` refuses mutable GitHub links in `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/*.md`; `PublishReleaseNoteOrphan.spec.mjs` pins the file's path.

## The Fix

Edit `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v14.0.0.md`: the banner to iteration 3, each chapter brought to `dev`, the new arcs placed (as chapters where the mining is deep, in *Also in 14* otherwise), the upgrade table extended, the community table rerun, and the examples chapter's bound restated from Friday's read.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Each chapter states what merged on its arc since 2026-11-16T02:20Z, each claim anchored to its issue or pull request. The planning chapter names four families.
- [ ] AC-2: *Upgrading from 13.4.0* carries the plain-CSS theme sources, the file server and the package contents, plus every behaviour change merged since iteration 2, each read against its diff; the `package.json` delta is re-read against `13.4.0`.
- [ ] AC-3: The examples chapter states Friday's gate read as its bound and claims only what is on `dev`.
- [ ] AC-4: The scale line and the outside-contributor table are re-counted by live GitHub search, each with its timestamp.
- [ ] AC-5: The board line and *What you can try* follow the #20874 reading if it is posted before the PR leaves draft; otherwise the note says the reading is pending and iteration 4 carries it.
- [ ] AC-6: Every new hero chapter has its release-notes §3 mining behind it (at least three Memory Core calls per arc, listed in the PR body).
- [ ] AC-7: `Generate.spec.mjs` and `PublishReleaseNoteOrphan.spec.mjs` pass, every link resolves, the note renders at its Portal route, and a cross-family review approves before merge.

## Out of Scope

- The final iteration: banner off, counts at the cut head, designations, the §7 checklist (#21033's cut-prep).
- The engine's class count in the README and the Portal (Clio's defect-note of 2026-11-20 13:43Z): not a claim this note makes.
- Outbound posts (#21041).

## Avoided Traps

- **A changelog dump.** 241 merges do not become 241 lines: the chapters carry the story, and *Also in 14* groups the rest by area (§5).
- **Reporting an open cornerstone as finished.** The examples section did not pass Friday's read; its chapter says what it delivered and what it still owes.
